findings.title: XSS Filter Bypass via Unclosed HTML Tag
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the 'name' GET parameter in the HTML response. The server applies a regex-based HTML tag filter (`<[^>]*>`) that strips all complete HTML tags. However, by omitting the closing `>` from an img tag with an event handler, the filter does not match and the incomplete tag is reflected as-is. In modern browsers, an `` tag without a closing `>` is still parsed when followed by content (like ``) causing the onerror handler to execute. The server-side check recognized this as a valid XSS payload and returned the CTF flag.
